newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT - Bradesco still a hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Bradesco still a hold.

text.p: -- ING Barings said in a report it was maintaining its hold rating for Brazil's largest retail bank Bradesco.
-- It raised 1997 earnings estimates to $1.04 per 1,000 shares from the previous $0.98 due to the bank's aggressive strategy in cutting staff and administrative costs, it said.
-- "Despite the increase in 1997 earnings estimates and the underperformance of the stock versus the local index in the last six months, we believe it is too early to go into the stock," it said.
-- Profitability is expected to remain low despite expectations of cost reductions during 1997, it said.
-- Bradesco is likely to remain overcapitalized as management is still conservative in expanding its loan portfolio.
-- Bradesco preferred shares were trading at 8.65 reais, up 0.58 percent.
